name: sai-yadadri-seva-ashram-platform
description: Sai Yadadri Seva Ashram — Website & Donation Platform (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint:fix --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api
